vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: skywork-music-maker
Version: 1.0.0

The skywork-music-maker skill is a well-documented tool for interacting with the Mureka AI music generation API. The Python script (scripts/mureka.py) implements standard API interaction patterns, including task polling and file uploads/downloads, using the legitimate 'api.mureka.ai' endpoint. The instructions in SKILL.md are focused on improving output quality through structured prompt engineering and user confirmation, with no evidence of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or prompt injection attacks.

llm.summary: The skill is largely what it claims (an agent wrapper around Mureka's music API), but registry metadata omits the required API credential and the instructions/scripts will upload user audio/lyrics to an external service — a privacy/billing mismatch that you should understand before installing.

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md, README, and scripts all require and use a MUREKA_API_KEY and make network calls to https://api.mureka.ai; however the registry metadata lists no required environment variables or primary credential. This is an incoherence between declared requirements and actual capability.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions stay within the stated purpose (convert text prompts, validate, then call Mureka API). They explicitly instruct the agent to upload reference/vocal files and to save output and lyrics to a user-specified or inferred directory — expected for this skill, but it means the agent will transmit user files and generated content to a third-party API.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec (instruction-only), which is low-risk. The repository includes a Python script (scripts/mureka.py) that will be executed by an agent or when invoked; nothing in the package performs a remote download or hidden install.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The code requires a single API key (MUREKA_API_KEY) and uses it for all API actions — this is proportionate for a third-party API, but the registry failed to declare it. Additionally, the skill uploads user-provided audio (references, vocal samples, melodies) to the remote service, which is a privacy-sensitive action that should be made explicit in the metadata/policy before installation.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request permanent platform-wide privileges or modify other skills. It writes outputs to user-specified output directories (normal behavior) but does not attempt to alter system-wide agent configuration.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill will call https://api.mureka.ai and requires you to set MUREKA_API_KEY (the code exits if that env var is not present), but the registry metadata did not declare that requirement — treat that as an oversight. Before installing: (1) Confirm you trust platform.mureka.ai because the skill will upload audio (reference tracks, vocal samples) and lyrics to the third party; do not upload private or sensitive recordings unless you accept that. (2) Protect your API key (use an account with minimal scope/limits and watch billing). (3) Expect the agent to create directories and write audio/lyrics files to the output path it chooses if you don’t pass one. (4) If you need stronger assurances, ask the publisher to update the registry metadata to declare MUREKA_API_KEY as a required credential and to include a privacy note describing what data is uploaded. If you cannot verify the publisher or the API privacy/billing terms, consider not installing or use with a throwaway/limited API key.
